questions.question: What does 'F1' stand for?
questions.explanation: Formula One is the top class of single-seater racing.

questions.question: Which team uses prancing horse as its emblem?
questions.explanation: Scuderia Ferrari's logo is a prancing horse.

questions.question: Which driver won seven F1 world championships alongside Michael Schumacher?
questions.explanation: Hamilton tied Schumacher's seven titles in 2020.

questions.question: What colour flag is waved at the end of a race?
questions.explanation: The chequered flag signals the finish.

questions.question: Which Dutch driver won titles from 2021 to 2024?
questions.explanation: Verstappen won four consecutive titles with Red Bull.

questions.question: Which country is Monza's famous F1 circuit in?
questions.explanation: Monza hosts the Italian Grand Prix.

questions.question: Which circuit hosts the Monaco Grand Prix?
questions.explanation: It is a street circuit through Monte Carlo.

questions.question: What does DRS stand for in F1?
questions.explanation: DRS opens the rear wing flap to reduce drag.

questions.question: How many points does a race winner get in a Grand Prix?
questions.explanation: Points go 25-18-15-12-10-8-6-4-2-1 for the top ten.

questions.question: Which team is based in Woking, England and uses papaya orange?
questions.explanation: McLaren Racing was founded by Bruce McLaren.

questions.question: Which driver won the 2008 title by a single point?
questions.explanation: Hamilton passed Timo Glock on the final lap in Brazil.

questions.question: Which circuit is known as the 'Temple of Speed'?
questions.explanation: Monza is one of the fastest circuits.

questions.question: Which tyre company is the sole F1 supplier?
questions.explanation: Pirelli has supplied since 2011.

questions.question: Who is the only driver to win the F1 title posthumously?
questions.explanation: Rindt died at Monza in 1970 and won the title.

questions.question: Which driver won three titles and died at Imola in 1994?
questions.explanation: Senna was Brazilian and raced for McLaren and Williams.

questions.question: Which circuit is nicknamed the 'Green Hell'?
questions.explanation: It is a 20 km track in Germany.

questions.question: Which Finnish driver won the 2007 world title for Ferrari?
questions.explanation: Räikkönen won by one point.

questions.question: Which year did Hamilton first win the F1 title?
questions.explanation: He drove for McLaren.

questions.question: What is 'parc fermé'?
choices: The restricted area where cars are kept under regulations
questions.explanation: Teams cannot freely modify cars after qualifying.

questions.question: Which country hosts the Suzuka circuit?
questions.explanation: Suzuka's figure-eight layout is unique.

questions.question: Which driver holds the record for most Grand Prix wins?
questions.explanation: Hamilton passed 100 wins.

questions.question: Who won the first F1 World Championship in 1950?
questions.explanation: Farina drove an Alfa Romeo.

questions.question: Which Brazilian circuit is known for its Senna 'S' curve?
questions.explanation: Interlagos is in São Paulo.

questions.question: Which constructor has won the most Constructors' Championships?
questions.explanation: Ferrari has 16 titles.

questions.question: Which team did Michael Schumacher win five consecutive titles with?
questions.explanation: Ferrari won 2000-2004.

questions.question: Which engine type replaced V8s in F1 in 2014?
questions.explanation: Hybrid power units arrived in 2014.

questions.question: Which street circuit in Singapore holds the first F1 night race (2008)?
questions.explanation: Marina Bay hosted the first night race.

questions.question: What is a 'safety car' used for?
choices: To slow the field after an incident
questions.explanation: Cars must queue behind the safety car.

questions.question: How many races are there on the 2024 F1 calendar?
questions.explanation: The record calendar had 24 races.
